tools.name: zendesk_tickets
tools.title: Zendesk Tickets
tools.description:
Zendesk Tickets. Specify the operation and its parameters.

Available operations:
- **get_ticket**: Retrieve a Zendesk ticket by ID, including its comments if requested.
- **get_ticket_attachments**: Retrieve ticket attachments.
- **search_tickets**: Search tickets using Zendesk query syntax (e.g., "status:open assignee:me", "priority:urgent type:incident").
- **create_ticket**: Create a new Zendesk support ticket with subject, description, and optional priority/type/assignee/tags. (write)
- **update_ticket**: Update an existing ticket (status, priority, type, assignee, group, subject, tags, custom fields). (write)
- **add_private_note**: Add an internal note (not visible to requester) to a ticket. (write)
- **add_public_comment**: Add a public comment (visible to requester) to a ticket. (write)
- **list_tickets**: List tickets with cursor-based pagination, sorted by most recently updated.
- **get_linked_incidents**: Get all incident tickets linked to a problem ticket.
- **manage_tags**: Add or remove tags on a ticket. (write)
- **search**: Search across tickets, users, and organizations.

operation.description: One of: get_ticket, get_ticket_attachments, search_tickets, create_ticket, update_ticket, add_private_note, add_public_comment, list_tickets, get_linked_incidents, manage_tags, search

tools.name: zendesk_help_center
tools.title: Zendesk Help Center
tools.description:
Zendesk Help Center. Specify the operation and its parameters.

Available operations:
- **search_articles**: Full-text search across Help Center articles (metadata only, no body).
- **get_article**: Retrieve an article by ID with full body content.
- **list_categories**: List all Help Center categories.
- **list_sections**: List sections, optionally filtered by category ID and locale.
- **list_articles**: List articles (metadata only, no body).
- **list_article_translations**: List all available translations for an article (metadata only, no body: locale, title, draft, updated_at).
- **create_article_translation**: Create a translation for an existing article in a specific locale. (write)
- **update_article_translation**: Update article content (title, body) in a specific locale. (write)
- **list_permission_groups**: List all Guide permission groups.
- **create_article**: Create a new article in a section. (write)
- **update_article**: Update article metadata only (draft, promoted, labels, tags, visibility, section, sort position, etc.). (write)
- **list_content_tags**: List all Guide content tags.
- **create_content_tag**: Create a new content tag for Guide articles. (write)
- **list_labels**: List all article labels.
- **list_user_segments**: List all user segments.
- **list_article_attachments**: List all attachments for an article.
- **get_article_outline**: Return a compact outline of an article (list of sections delimited by h1/h2/h3, with word counts) for the given locale (defaults to source_locale).
- **get_article_section**: Retrieve the content of a single section of an article in a given locale.
- **update_article_section**: Replace the content of a single section of an article in a given locale, keeping the rest of the body intact. (write)
- **compare_translations**: Compare section structure between two locales of the same article, matched by index.
- **create_article_attachment**: Upload an attachment to an article. (write)

operation.description: One of: search_articles, get_article, list_categories, list_sections, list_articles, list_article_translations, create_article_translation, update_article_translation, list_permission_groups, create_article, update_article, list_content_tags, create_content_tag, list_labels, list_user_segments, list_article_attachments, get_article_outline, get_article_section, update_article_section, compare_translations, create_article_attachment

tools.name: zendesk_users
tools.title: Zendesk Users
tools.description:
Zendesk Users. Specify the operation and its parameters.

Available operations:
- **get_current_user**: Get the currently authenticated Zendesk user.
- **search_users**: Search for users by name, email, or other criteria using Zendesk search query syntax.
- **get_user**: Retrieve a user by ID.
- **get_organization**: Retrieve an organization by ID.
- **list_organizations**: List all organizations with pagination.

operation.description: One of: get_current_user, search_users, get_user, get_organization, list_organizations
